title: Tech Note: Colors with User Interface in 4D
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Color theory, WCAG contrast ratios, and color-harmony math are timeless and still cited today (WCAG has since progressed to 2.1/2.2 with refined criteria); the 4D-specific color manipulation code (RGB/HSL conversions via classic commands) still runs, though modern UI work increasingly happens via CSS-styled web forms or Qodly, where color theory is applied through stylesheets rather than 4D method code.
